ageDivisions.notes: Must be age 7 by Dec 31 for national competition.
Introduces triple jump, pole vault and steeplechase.
Adds hammer throw; heptathlon and decathlon available.
Athletes turning 18 by the last day of nationals remain eligible.

ageDivisionNotes: Youth competition takes place in two-year age divisions. Age is calculated as of December 31 of the competition year.
Combined events (triathlon, pentathlon, heptathlon, decathlon) do not count toward event limits.
Athletes may only compete in events designated for their age group.

pathway.title: Development
pathway.body: Every athlete starts somewhere. New athletes learn fundamentals — form, starts, exchanges, pacing — at their neighborhood practice site with USATF-experienced coaches. No tryouts. Ages 7–18, every experience level.

pathway.title: Competition
pathway.body: The spring season runs through Houston-area invitationals and Track Houston's own meets, building toward the USATF Gulf Association championships. Cross country runs September through December.

pathway.title: Championships
pathway.body: Athletes who qualify advance from Association to Region to the USATF National Junior Olympic Championships — a pipeline Track Houston feeds every single year, at volume.

scholars.headline: Excellence begins in the classroom.
scholars.body: Track Houston's Academic & Life Skills program backs every athlete's path to college: NCAA eligibility monitoring, FAFSA help, athlete profiles for college coaches, campus visit coordination and honor-roll recognition each grading period.

club800.title: The 800 Club SAT/ACT Course
club800.body: Free test prep exclusively for Track Houston athletes — open to sophomores, juniors and seniors who have completed or are enrolled in Algebra II.
